youtube_description:
Pull-ups are the king of back exercises. If you want a wide back and a V-taper physique, this is the exercise that builds it.

Grab the bar just outside your shoulders. Hang almost all the way down, but never fully straighten your arms. Pull your chin over the bar, driving your elbows down to your sides, then lower yourself slowly. No swinging.

If you can't do one yet, use the assisted pull-up machine and use a little less assistance each week. Also do slow negatives: get your chin over the bar, then lower yourself as slowly as you can.
